author: Will_29
body:
In my experience, for a horde battle to count you need to defeat *everyone* with only super-effective attacks. So it's very trick to get any results in a horde boss dungeon, or with the typical god+two followers tower encounter.

But I also defeated a lone arisen Demeter with Quakestorms, and it didn't count either. So avoid omnimancy as well.

I did what someone else suggested in another thread, and used a few Celestial Stardrops I had stored up from last year. Just go for the T10 giants and use lightning spells.
